verses.sloka: कृत अभिषेको रामः तु सीता सौमित्रिर् एव च ।तस्मात् गोदावरी तीरात् ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आश्रमम् ॥३-१७-१॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta abhiṣeko rāmaḥ tu sītā saumitrir eva ca ।tasmāt godāvarī tīrāt tato jagmuḥ svam āśramam ॥3-17-1॥

translations.english: Ablution over, Rama, accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana, went back from the bank of the river Godabari to their hermitage.
translations.hindi: वळ. अरख्यकाएड का सोलहवा सर्ग पूरा हुआ । "णास" — SES , १ स्दुबन्ति-उपतस्थिरे । (गो० ) २ देवता:--सन्ध्यादि देवता: । (गो०) ह Ribose का कृताभिषेको रामस्तु सीता सोमित्रिरेव च । तस्माइगादावरीतीरासतो जग्मुः खमाश्रमम्‌

verses.sloka: आश्रमम् तम् उपागम्य राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः ।कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकम् कर्म पर्णशालाम् उपागमत् ॥३-१७-२॥
verses.transliteration: āśramam tam upāgamya rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।kṛtvā paurvāhṇikam karma parṇaśālām upāgamat ॥3-17-2॥

translations.english: On reaching the hermitage, Rama and Lakshmana performed the forenoon rituals and entered the leafthatched cottage.

verses.sloka: उवास सुखितः तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षभः।स रामः पर्ण शालायाम् आसीनः सह सीतया ॥३-१७-३॥
verses.transliteration: uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra pūjyamāno maharṣabhaḥ।sa rāmaḥ parṇa śālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā ॥3-17-3॥

translations.english: Honoured by the ascetics , Rama stayed there peacefully with brother Lakshmana, discussing diverse matters (from time to time).
translations.hindi: वहाँ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी महर्पियों द्वारा पूजित हो कर, सुख से रहने लगे ओर लक्ष्मण से अनेक प्रकार की पुराण एवं इतिहासा की कथाएँ कहने लगे

verses.sloka: विरराज महा बाहुः चित्रया चन्द्रमा इव ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः ॥३-१७-४॥
verses.transliteration: virarāja mahā bāhuḥ citrayā candramā iva ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ ॥3-17-4॥

translations.english: Longarmed Rama seated with Sita in the cottage, appeared like the Moon in conjunction with constellation Chitra.
translations.hindi: उस परशाला में सीता जी के साथ बैठे हुए महाबाहु श्रीरामचन्द्र जी, वैसे हा शोभित होते थे, जेसे चित्रा नक्षत्र के सहित चन्द्रमा शोभित होता हे

verses.sloka: तदा आसीनस्य रामस्य कथा संसक्त चेतसः ।तम् देशम् राक्षसी काचिद् आजगाम यदृच्छया ॥३-१७-५॥
verses.transliteration: tadā āsīnasya rāmasya kathā saṁsakta cetasaḥ ।tam deśam rākṣasī kācid ājagāma yadṛcchayā ॥3-17-5॥

translations.english: While Rama was thus seated, engrossed in conversation, there incidentally appeared a demoness.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी तो बैठे हुए बातचीत कर रहे थे कि, इतने में एक राक्षसी अकस्मात्‌ वहाँ जा पहुँची

verses.sloka: सा तु शूर्पणखा नाम दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः ।भगिनी रामम् आसाद्य ददर्श त्रिदश उपमम् ॥३-१७-६॥
verses.transliteration: sā tu śūrpaṇakhā nāma daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ ।bhaginī rāmam āsādya dadarśa tridaśa upamam ॥3-17-6॥

translations.english: Surpanakha, sister of the tenheaded demon (Ravana) approached Rama shining like a god.
translations.hindi: उस राक्षसी का नाम शूपेनखा था ओर बह रावण की बहिन थी । देवताओं के समान, सिंह जेसी छाती वाले, सहाबाइ, कमल पत्र के समान विशाल नेत्र बाले, घुटनों तक लंबी सुचाओं वाले, तेजस्वी, देखने सें अतीव सुन्दर, सद्रत गज छी तरह चलने बाले, जटामर्डलधारी, सुकुमार, सहाबलवान, राजलक्षणौं से युक्त, नील कमल के तुल्य श्याम वशुबाले और कामदेव के समान सुन्दर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को इन्द्र की तरह बैठा हुआ देख, वह राक्षसी काम से मोहित हो गई अर्थात्‌ उन पर आसक्त हो गई

verses.sloka: दीप्तास्यम् च महाबाहुम् पद्म पत्रायत  ईक्षणम् ।गज विक्रांत गमनम् जटा मण्दल धारिणम् ॥३-१७-७॥
verses.transliteration: dīptāsyam ca mahābāhum padma patrāyata  īkṣaṇam ।gaja vikrāṁta gamanam jaṭā maṇdala dhāriṇam ॥3-17-7॥

translations.english: The demoness was infatuated with Rama, whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted, who was gentle and strong who was, endowed with royal traits, who had a blue lotuslike complexion, who was handsome as the god of love, and who resembled Indra.

verses.sloka: सुकुमारम् महा सत्त्वम् पार्थिव व्यंजन अन्वितम् ।रामम् इन्दीवर श्यामम् कन्दर्प सदृश प्रभम् ॥३-१७-८॥
verses.transliteration: sukumāram mahā sattvam pārthiva vyaṁjana anvitam ।rāmam indīvara śyāmam kandarpa sadṛśa prabham ॥3-17-8॥

translations.english: The demoness was infatuated with Rama, whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted, who was gentle and strong who was, endowed with royal traits, who had a blue lotuslike complexion, who was handsome as the god of love, and who resembled Indra.

verses.sloka: बभूव इन्द्रोपमम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काम मोहिता ।सुमुखम् दुर्मुखी रामम् वृत्त मध्यम् महोदरी ॥३-१७-९॥
verses.transliteration: babhūva indropamam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasī kāma mohitā ।sumukham durmukhī rāmam vṛtta madhyam mahodarī ॥3-17-9॥

translations.english: The demoness was infatuated with Rama, whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted, who was gentle and strong who was, endowed with royal traits, who had a blue lotuslike complexion, who was handsome as the god of love, and who resembled Indra.

verses.sloka: विशालाक्षम् विरूपाक्षी सुकेशम् ताम्र मूर्धजा ।प्रियरूपम् विरूपा सा सुस्वरम् भैरव स्वना ॥३-१७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: viśālākṣam virūpākṣī sukeśam tāmra mūrdhajā ।priyarūpam virūpā sā susvaram bhairava svanā ॥3-17-10॥

translations.english: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large, hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust. (This) demoness said to Rama :
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का मुख सुन्दर था और उस राक्षसी का बरा । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के शरीर का मध्यभाग न बहुत बड़ा था न छोटा था ओर उस राक्षसी के शरीर का सध्य भाग बहुत बड़ा था अथात्‌ वह बड़े पेट वाली थी । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के नेत्र बड़े बड़े थे ओर उस राक्षसा के नेत्र बिकट थे । श्रीरामचन्द्र जो के सिर के केश नीले थे ओर उस राक्षसी के लाल लाल थे

verses.sloka: तरुणम् दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणम् वाम भाषिणी ।न्याय वृत्तम् सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियम् अप्रिय दर्शना ॥३-१७-११॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇam dāruṇā vṛddhā dakṣiṇam vāma bhāṣiṇī ।nyāya vṛttam sudurvṛttā priyam apriya darśanā ॥3-17-11॥

translations.english: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large, hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust. (This) demoness said to Rama :
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी देखने सें सुन्दर थे ओर वह राक्षसी देखने में महाकुरूपा थी । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का कण्ठस्वर ,मघुर था, उस राक्षसी का नितान्त कर्कश । श्रीरासचन्द्र जी जवान थे और वह राक्षसी ग्रहावृद्धा थी । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अत्यन्त सधुरभाषी थे ओर राक्षसी सदा ठेढी ही वातें बोला करती थी

verses.sloka: शरीरज समाविष्टा राक्षसी रामम् अब्रवीत् ।जटी तापस रूपेण सभार्यः शर चाप धृक् ॥३-१७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: śarīraja samāviṣṭā rākṣasī rāmam abravīt ।jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa sabhāryaḥ śara cāpa dhṛk ॥3-17-12॥

translations.english: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large, hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust. (This) demoness said to Rama :
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का आचरण उचित था ओर उस रासी का अत्यन्त गर्हित । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी देखने में जितने प्रिय थे बह' राक्षसी उतनी ही भयङ्कर थी। ऐसी वह राक्षसी कामातुर हो, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से वोली

verses.sloka: आगतः त्वम् इमम् देशम् कथम् राक्षस सेवितम् ।किम् आगमन कृत्यम् ते तत् त्वम् आख्यातुम् अर्हसि ॥३-१७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: āgataḥ tvam imam deśam katham rākṣasa sevitam ।kim āgamana kṛtyam te tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi ॥3-17-13॥

translations.english: O Rama you are wearing matted hair like an ascetic, but living with your wife and holding bow and arrows. What brings you to this place haunted by demons ? You should tell me the truth ?
translations.hindi: जरा धारण किए, तपस्वी का भेष बनाए और तीर कमान लिये, छी सहित, तुम इस राक्षसा से सेबित वन में, क्यों आए हो ?

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु राक्षस्या शूर्पणख्या परंतपः ।ऋजु बुद्धितया सर्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे ॥३-१७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rākṣasyā śūrpaṇakhyā paraṁtapaḥ ।ṛju buddhitayā sarvam ākhyātum upacakrame ॥3-17-14॥

translations.english: Thus asked by the demoness Surpanakha, Rama, scorcher of foes began telling her everything due to his simplemindedness.
translations.hindi: ऋजुबुष्धितयाः सवमाख्यातुमुपचक्रसे । अन्त न हि रामस्य कदाचिदपि सम्मतम्‌ ॥१५]! तुम्हारे यहाँ आने का क्या प्रयोजन है, ठीक ठीक बवलाओ । शत्र के तपाने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने शूपनखः! के ये बचन सन्‌, सरलता से, अपना समस्त वृत्तान्त कहना आरम्भ किआ । क्योंकि श्रीरामचन्द्र कूठ बोलना कभी, पसन्द नहीं करते

verses.sloka: आसीत् दशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदश विक्रमः ।तस्य अहम् अग्रजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः ॥३-१७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: āsīt daśaratho nāma rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ ।tasya aham agrajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ ॥3-17-15॥

translations.english: To Rama untruth is never acceptable at the hermitage and especially in the presence of a woman.

verses.sloka: भ्राता अयम् लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान् माम् अनुव्रतः ।इयम् भार्या च वैदेही मम सीतेति विश्रुता ॥३-१७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātā ayam lakṣmaṇo nāma yavīyān mām anuvrataḥ ।iyam bhāryā ca vaidehī mama sīteti viśrutā ॥3-17-16॥

translations.english: (Rama replied) There was a king named Dasaratha who was mighty like the gods. I am his eldest son known among the people as Rama.
translations.hindi: ॥ बिशेषेणा श्रमस्थस्य समीपे स्रीजतस्य च ¦ आसीहशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः ।¦१६।। सो भी बिशेष कर तपोवन में वेठ कर आर खिया के सामने । अतः श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने कहा-_देवलुल्य पराक्रमी महाराज दशरथ नाम के महाराज थे

verses.sloka: नियोगात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य पितुर् मातुः च यंत्रितः ।धर्मार्थम् धर्मकांक्षी च वनम् वस्तुम् इह आगतः ॥३-१७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: niyogāt tu narendrasya pitur mātuḥ ca yaṁtritaḥ ।dharmārtham dharmakāṁkṣī ca vanam vastum iha āgataḥ ॥3-17-17॥

translations.english: Here is Lakshmana , my younger brother, who always follows me . And this is the daughter of the king of Videha and my wife, wellknown as Sita.
translations.hindi: तस्याहमग्रजः पुत्रो रासो नाम जनेः श्रुतः । श्राताऽयं लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान सामचुत्रतः !!१७॥ उन्हींका में अ्येष्ठपुत्र हूँ । संसार मे में राम के नाम से प्रांसद्ध हँ । यह मेरा आज्ञाकारी छोटा भाई है। इसका नाम लक्ष्रण है

verses.sloka: त्वाम् तु वेदितुम् इच्छामि कस्य त्वम् का असि कस्य वा ।त्वम् हि तावन्मनोज्ञांगी राक्षसी प्रतिभासि मे ॥३-१७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tvām tu veditum icchāmi kasya tvam kā asi kasya vā ।tvam hi tāvanmanojñāṁgī rākṣasī pratibhāsi me ॥3-17-18॥

translations.english: I have come here, commanded by the king, my father and mother.Intending to obey the orders of my father, and impelled by duty to establish righteousness I have come to reside here.
translations.hindi: ऋजुबुद्धितया--सरलस्वभावेन । (शि०) २ श्राश्रमस्थस्प--तपोवनस्थस्य ( योऽ) है संतदरा: सग. > A @ इयं भाया च वेढेही मम सीतेति विश्रता । नेयोगात्त र नरन्ट्रस्य पितुमातुश्च यान्त्रतः^

verses.sloka: इह वा किम् निमित्तम् त्वम् आगता ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ।सा अब्रवीत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदन अर्दिता ॥३-१७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: iha vā kim nimittam tvam āgatā brūhi tattvataḥ ।sā abravīt vacanam śrutvā rākṣasī madana arditā ॥3-17-19॥

translations.english: I wish to know who you are. Tell me who your kins are. With lovely limbs you do not appear to be a demoness.

verses.sloka: श्रूयताम् राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थम् वचनम् मम ।अहम् शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी ॥३-१७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārtham vacanam mama ।aham śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī ॥3-17-20॥

translations.english: Tell me truly what you have come here for. Having heard the words of Rama and overtaken by passion, the demoness said:

verses.sloka: अरण्यम् विचरामि इदम् एका सर्व भयंकरा ।रावणो नाम मे भ्राता यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः ॥३-१७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṁkarā ।rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ ॥3-17-21॥

translations.english: My name is Surpanakha. I am a demoness who can assume any form at will, I move in this forest alone, unleashing a reign of terror.

verses.sloka: वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः ।प्रवृद्ध निद्रः च सदा कुंभकर्णो महाबलः ॥३-१७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vīro viśravasaḥ putro yadi te śrotram āgataḥ ।pravṛddha nidraḥ ca sadā kuṁbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ॥3-17-22॥

translations.english: My name is Surpanakha. I am a demoness who can assume any form at will, I move in this forest alone, unleashing a reign of terror.

verses.sloka: विभीषणः तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षस चेष्टितः ।प्रख्यात वीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खर दूषणौ ॥३-१७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasa ceṣṭitaḥ ।prakhyāta vīryau ca raṇe bhrātarau khara dūṣaṇau ॥3-17-23॥

translations.english: My brother is Ravana, son of Visrava, and lord of all demons. You have heard his name I suppose.

verses.sloka: तान् अहम् समतिक्रान्ता राम त्वा पूर्व दर्शनात् ।समुपेता अस्मि भावेन भर्तारम् पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥३-१७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tān aham samatikrāntā rāma tvā pūrva darśanāt ।samupetā asmi bhāvena bhartāram puruṣottamam ॥3-17-24॥

translations.english: Kumbhakarna is another brother of mine. He is very strong. He is always in deep sleep. Vibhisna another brother. He is righteous free from any demoniac trait. My other two brothers are Khara and Dusana who are wellknown heroes of war.

verses.sloka: अहम् प्रभाव संपन्ना स्वच्छंद बल गामिनी ।चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किम् करिष्यसि ॥३-१७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: aham prabhāva saṁpannā svacchaṁda bala gāminī ।cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi ॥3-17-25॥

translations.english: Setting them aside, I came here, as soon as I saw you. You are the finest among men and I am here wishing you to be my husband.

verses.sloka: विकृता च विरूपा च न सा इयम् सदृशी तव ।अहम् एव अनुरूपा ते भार्या रूपेण पश्य माम् ॥३-१७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vikṛtā ca virūpā ca na sā iyam sadṛśī tava ।aham eva anurūpā te bhāryā rūpeṇa paśya mām ॥3-17-26॥

translations.english: I have influence over others, I have capacity to move wherever I want. Be my husband forever. What will you do with Sita?

verses.sloka: इमाम् विरूपाम् असतीम् करालाम् निर्णत उदरीम् ।अनेन सह ते भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम् ॥३-१७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm ।anena saha te bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm ॥3-17-27॥

translations.english: She is ugly, deformed, unsuitable for you. I am alone fit for you. Look upon me as your wife.

verses.sloka: ततः पर्वत शृंगाणि वनानि विविधानि च ।पश्यन्सहमयाकामीदण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि - यद्वा - पश्यन् सह मया कामी दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि ॥३-१७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parvata śṛṁgāṇi vanāni vividhāni ca ।paśyansahamayākāmīdaṇḍakānvicariṣyasi - yadvā - paśyan saha mayā kāmī daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi ॥3-17-28॥

translations.english: I will devour your brother along with this disfigured, unchaste and fearful lady with a flat belly.

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्तः काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिर ईक्षणाम् ।इदम् वचनम् आरेभे वक्तुम् वाक्य विशारदः ॥३-१७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktaḥ kākutsthaḥ prahasya madira īkṣaṇām ।idam vacanam ārebhe vaktum vākya viśāradaḥ ॥3-17-29॥

translations.english: O darling, thereafter you can keep wandering with me in this Dandaka forest, enjoying the beauty of the mountain tops and forests.
